season: # Which picture each season shows when the middle follows the season: the web
# page's Artwork: By season, and church_year_image.py --art-date.  A day in a season
# with no row here keeps the church's own picture (tradition.csv: center_art).
# season: a season's name as the wheel's ring and readout give it (Advent), or
#         its word in the season files (ADVENT), which holds in every language.
# art:    a key from artwork.csv; blank for the church's own picture.
# church: one church's key (traditions.csv), or blank for every church.  A
#         church's own row wins, by name and then by word; then every church's,
#         by word and then by name.
# week:   the week of the season the picture comes in with (1 is the season's
#         first seven days), or blank for the whole season.  Of a season's
#         rows, the one for the latest week that has come is shown.
# Advent: a candle more each week (week 4 stays for any days after).
# The one-year series: Easter's later weeks, and the days from the Ascension.
# The Eastern churches' seasons, whose word is only FEAST or FAST: by name.
# The older prayer books keep Christmas white through the octave of the
# Epiphany; the season is the Epiphany from 6 January all the same.
# Ordinary Time between the Epiphany and Lent is not a festival season: the
# church's own picture (a row with no art).
